d: Reports to: Construction Manager / Tunnelling Manager

The Lifting Supervisor is responsible for the safe planning, coordination, supervision and execution of lifting operations associated with Horizontal Directional Drilling (HDD), microtunnelling, shaft works and associated construction activities.

The role ensures that lifting operations are carried out in accordance with approved lifting plans, RAMS, project procedures, manufacturers' requirements and applicable Bahrain health and safety requirements.
q: Experience with deep shafts and blind lifting operations.
Experience handling tunnel pipes and heavy tunnelling machinery.
Experience with crawler and mobile cranes.
NEBOSH, IOSH or equivalent HSE training.
ability to read crane load charts;
experience working around heavy tunnelling equipment.
We are one of the UK's leading civil engineering and tunnelling contractors, offering a wide range of construction and specialist services.
r: Supervise all lifting operations associated with HDD, microtunnelling and shaft activities.
Conduct pre-lift briefings/toolbox talks with crane operators, riggers and banksmen before lifting activities commence.
Ensure the correct crane, lifting accessories, rigging arrangement and lifting method are used.
Verify crane capacity against lifting radius, boom configuration, load weight and ground conditions.
Confirm operators, riggers and banksmen hold appropriate competency certification.
Inspect the work area before lifting, including:
Confirm lifting equipment and accessories have valid inspection/test certification and are within their SWL/WLL.
Ensure lifting accessories are correctly selected for the load, including slings, shackles, spreader beams, lifting beams and chain blocks.
Establish and maintain effective exclusion zones around lifting operations.
Maintain clear communication between the crane operator, banksman/signaller and lifting team.
Stop any lifting operation where conditions differ from the approved lifting plan or where the operation becomes unsafe.
Supervise lifting and handling associated with
lifting and positioning equipment within HDD entry and exit areas.
lowering and recovering equipment from launch and reception shafts.
The Lifting Supervisor shall review the approved lift plan before work starts and verify that actual site conditions correspond with the plan.
load weight and centre of gravity;
interaction with other plant and activities.
Responsible for checking and maintaining site records including
Recognised Lifting Supervisor qualification/certification suitable for the project and accepted in Bahrain.
Minimum 5 years' lifting experience, preferably within heavy civil engineering, utilities, tunnelling, HDD, pipeline or shaft construction.
Practical knowledge of mobile crane operations and crane load charts.
Ability to understand lifting plans and rigging drawings.
Good understanding of SWL/WLL, sling angles, load centres of gravity and crane working radius.
